name: cave_of_numbers
theme: a limestone cave whose glowworm ceiling plays the cosmos â€” down a banded stalactite into the calcite lattice, out into the glowworm sky, and home to the cavern floor

registers.name: cavern
registers.palette: glowworm blue-green on black wet stone
registers.scene: a vast limestone cavern seen from the cavern floor at the edge of a still dark pool, the black ceiling overhead strewn with small blue glowworm lights, ranks of pale stalactites hanging from it, wet flowstone terraces banking the walls, one great banded stalactite hanging among the ranks
registers.target: a great banded stalactite, a long pale limestone cone ringed with bands of amber and cream, its wet tip a fine sharp point
registers.loop_target: the vast limestone cavern seen from the floor at the edge of the still dark pool, blue glowworm lights strewn across the black ceiling and pale stalactites hanging overhead

registers.name: stalactite
registers.palette: pale cream stone and cold blue light
registers.scene: a great banded stalactite hanging from the cave roof, a long limestone cone ringed with bands of amber and cream, pale flowstone walls beyond it
registers.target: a wide amber calcite band, its surface rippled into stacked ridges

registers.name: calcite_bands
registers.scene: rippled calcite bands across the stone, long curved ridges of deep amber and dark cream, wet mineral shine along every ridge
registers.target: a glowing rhombic crystal, a slanted box of pale violet-white light

registers.name: calcite_lattice
registers.scene: the calcite crystal lattice, slanted rhombic cells of pale violet-white stacked away in every direction

registers.name: glowworm_sky
registers.scene: a black cave vault overhead crowded with glowworm light, thousands of blue-green points strewn across the dark, long fine silk threads hanging between them and catching the glow, the stone behind the lights lost in black
registers.target: a bright cluster of glowworm lamps, a close-packed knot of blue-green light

registers.name: glowworm_cluster
registers.palette: jade green lamps and pale silk
registers.scene: a dense field of glowworm lamps strung across the black cave vault, each a bead of jade-green light on a long silk thread, hundreds of them scattered deep into the dark
registers.target: a wide pale stone arch, an open cavern mouth

registers.name: cave_mouth
registers.palette: pale stone and deep night blue
registers.scene: the mouth of the cavern, a wide pale stone arch standing open on a dark valley of night hills, and beneath the lit ceiling the cavern floor of pale flowstone terraces and a still dark pool

music_theme: a hushed underground wonder â€” deep drones and glass bell tones under a slow luminous swell, one bright bloom of sound on the lattice-to-glowworm-sky morph, settling back to stillness at the pool
